summary: Performance lens of the story autoreview pass. The psutil port enumerates PIDs only (process_iter() bare) and reads environ/cmdline lazily per candidate, so the token sweep does O(candidates) syscalls instead of a bulk environ fetch — verified live against a 2040-process macOS table with no crash and no measurable delegate latency change. Termination keeps the poll/escalate cadence (PROCESS_POLL_SECONDS 0.02, 5s TERM→KILL) unchanged. doctor --fix adds one site.addsitedir call post-install (one-shot). No hot-path regressions found.

non_blocking_findings.summary: per-candidate lazy environ()/cmdline() bounds sweep cost to baseline-diff candidates; full-table eager fetch removed with the ps shell-outs

residual_risks: psutil process_iter on very large Windows process tables is unmeasured locally; windows-hook-gates exercises the real path
